summary: Forest County, WI steel tower built 1932; listed as standing, with a 2024 survey on the Wisconsin Historical Society record. No staffing, fire or access details found.

events.note: Forest Lookouts says a steel tower was erected in 1932; the Wisconsin Historical Society record gives year built 1932
First survey date on the Wisconsin Historical Society record
Second survey date on the Wisconsin Historical Society record; the building was still on file

evidence.supports: Forest County tower on National Forest land, township 36, range 15 East, section 20
historic name Laona Fire Lookout Tower
historic use observation and fire tower
no National or State Register listing
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as standing, with no register number

corrections.why: 36-15E-20 is a township, range and section, not an agency. Forest Lookouts lists the land as National Forest.

notes_for_editor: Built year 1932 agrees across Forest Lookouts and the Wisconsin Historical Society record. The newest evidence of standing is the 2024 survey date on the WHS record plus the FFLA list; no current photo or condition report was found. No staffing, notable fires or access rules were found in the sources read. The laonahistory.com site has a wildfire news index that might hold tower material; I did not follow it up. One WebSearch used for this tower, plus one before it. No new photos.
